records.name: Hooves
records.why: Prone rider is limited by target size; data has the save and prone status but nothing restricting it to Medium or smaller targets.

records.name: Multiattack
records.why: Multiattack only lists the attacks to make; the data utility activity needs nothing more in combat.

records.name: Radiant Lance
records.why: Data lacks the mark: until the archon's next turn, the target suffers disadvantage on attacks against anyone else. Needs an effect with a duration and a condition.

records.name: Archon's Pursuit
records.why: Reaction teleport triggered when a marked creature ends its turn within range; data has only an empty reaction utility.

records.name: Haunting Radiance
records.why: Reaction triggered right after a creature forces a save; blinded duration is until end of its next turn. Data has the save and status but not the trigger or timing.

records.name: Parry
records.why: Reaction AC bonus applies to one melee attack that would hit, only when the attacker is seen; data has a bonus effect but no trigger or visibility limit.

records.name: Legendary Resistance
records.why: Choice at use time to turn a failed save into a success; data only has a resource-spending utility activity.

records.name: Bite
records.why: Swallow rider: restrained, cover, ongoing start-of-turn damage, capacity, regurgitation on damage threshold, escape on death. Data lacks the swallow state and has no effects.

records.name: Multiattack
records.why: Multiattack only lists the attacks to make; nothing further to automate.

records.name: False Appearance
records.why: Advantage on initiative when motionless at combat start plus an investigation check gate; data has no effect or activity.

records.name: Leafy Handholds
records.why: Only grants others advantage on climb checks on the creature; no combat effect to automate.

records.name: Regeneration
records.why: Start-of-turn healing that is suppressed by fire or lightning damage taken; data heal activity has zero amount and no suppression condition.
